name: Judas Strife
original_name: ジューダス・ストライフ
source: [spoiler]He is the temporary vessel of Beelzebub after receive the blood of Beelzebub from the real vessel and gain immortality later. His last name, Strife, is mean as conflict and it given by Satanael to define his existence as conflict. His previous life is one of Lot underling but later he betrayed them and kill almost all of them, after that he cornered Lot to receive the sin of decay from Satanael[/spoiler]
